title: Fate/kaleid liner Prisma ☆ Illya Drei 3!!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Elementary-school magical girl Illya wakes in a parallel world where Fuyuki City lies in snowy ruins, separated from her partner Miyu and without her transformation. With allies she tries to rescue Miyu from the Ainsworth family, who want to use her as a Holy Grail, amid battles with powerful card-wielding opponents (MAL synopsis; ANN review of the anime adaptation).
life_message: Friendship and the will to save one person you love can stand against a system that would sacrifice her for the world.

content.note: Magical-girl battles with swords, spears and assassins (AniList tags); MAL reviewer calls 3rei the darkest arc, with graphic violence (to verify).
Ruined world, kidnapping and tragedy (AniList Tragedy spoiler tag); reviewers call it dark and edgy.
Ecchi genre on AniList and MU with a primarily child cast (Illya is 11); MAL reviewers mention fan service and 'sexual implications'; ANN says the anime toned it down (to verify).
Despair, memory loss and yandere obsession (AniList spoiler tags).
Spin-off of the Fate franchise with anime films; English release was one chapter and is defunct (MU).

folkways.japan: A Fate spin-off in the magical-girl genre; its mix of child heroines with fan service reflects a Japanese seinen/shounen market convention (lolicon-adjacent fan service), described here not judged.
